methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
Stage 4: The team analyzed ADGAS assets to identify energy users and classified them into three
levels of performance indicators. Level 1 indicators being the high level indicators e.g. overall energy
consumption per unit total product.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
ADGAS
implemented an Energy Management System (EnMS) which not only covers plant operations but
considers each and every aspect of the organization.

level_3b.evidence_quote:
ADGAS owns and operates three LNG trains; LNG trains 1 & 2 are commissioned in
1977 while the high capacity train 3 was commissioned in 1994. Beside LNG which is produced from a
special cryogenic column, the trains produce Propane, Butane, paraffinic Naphtha and Sulfur.
